hints.title: Prime Factor Connectivity
hints.text: Two numbers share a common factor greater than 1 if and only if they share at least one prime factor.

hints.title: Factor Graph Reduction
hints.text: Instead of checking all pairs of numbers, connect each number directly to all of its prime factors in a disjoint set.

hints.title: Disjoint Set Component Count
hints.text: For each number x in nums, find all prime factors d where d * d <= x. Union x with each prime factor d (and with x // d if prime). Finally, find the root representative of each number in nums and find the maximum frequency.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: M: maximum value in nums (up to 100,000)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise GCD checks between all pairs of elements requires O(N^2 * log M) steps, triggering severe timeout.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Connecting each number to its prime factors introduces at most O(sqrt(M)) operations per number.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that prime factor sharing is transitive: if A and B share prime p, they belong to the same component.
complexity.notes: Counting component sizes should only tally original numbers in nums, not arbitrary prime factors.
